summary: End-to-end verification of driver subscription flow after Stripe recurring migration + local proxy backend. Backend (9/9 pytest cases) and frontend (all 9 requested flows) PASS. Local FastAPI proxy correctly forwards /api/* to upstream SaaS; /health and /healthz return 200 with mongo=true. Driver login via proxy returns a JWT. GET /api/driver/subscription returns {enabled:true, status:active, monthly_amount_cents:5000, next_billing_at:2026-10-07, ...}. POST /api/driver/subscription/checkout returns a real Stripe Checkout URL (cs_live_...). The previous 'endpoint non disponible' error is NOT reproducible. Frontend: Welcome + Login screens render the dark wallpaper with overlay; after login the driver lands on the home map with exactly 4 tabs (Carte / Missions / Historique / Menu — Portefeuille hidden via href:null and HIDDEN_ROUTES set). Menu shows 'Portefeuille' (routes to /(tabs)/earnings) and 'Mon abonnement' with ACTIF badge. Subscription screen for the active driver shows: green 'Actif' badge, '50,00 € / mois', yellow 'Prélèvement automatique — carte sauvegardée par Stripe' box, 'Prochain prélèvement 07 octobre 2026', green 'Abonnement à jour — vous pouvez recevoir des courses' card, 'Gérer mon abonnement' + 'Résilier l’abonnement' buttons. When GET subscription is mocked to status=none, UI correctly flips: home button becomes red 'ABONNEMENT REQUIS' with red banner, menu shows red 'REQUIS' badge, subscription screen shows 'Compte bloqué' warn + yellow 'S’ABONNER' CTA. Clicking S’ABONNER POSTs to /api/driver/subscription/checkout with {origin_url:'http://localhost:3000'}; mocked Stripe response accepted, no error toast displayed. Deprecated packages detected: expo-av used by expo-notifications (indirect, not in app code — not a blocker).

issues: Minor: 'Permission de localisation refusée' banner appears on web preview (expected — Chromium denies geolocation). No action required.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web warnings — deprecated shadow* style props; recommend switching to boxShadow. References: app/(tabs)/index.tsx:403, 457, 462 (shiftBtn / liveCounter shadows).
props.pointerEvents is deprecated — move to style.pointerEvents. Reference: app/(tabs)/index.tsx:240 (top bar View).
'useNativeDriver' is not supported on web and falls back to JS-based animation. Cosmetic only; consider Platform.select to disable on web. Reference: app/(tabs)/index.tsx:50-52.

action_items: Optional: migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow for RN Web parity.
Optional: move pointerEvents from prop to style on home map top bar View.
Optional: disable useNativeDriver animations on web (Platform.OS === 'web' ? false : true).
No functional fixes required — subscription flow is production-ready.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend proxy correctly forwards hop-by-hop-filtered headers (Authorization preserved) and short-circuits /api/status + /health locally — good deploy-readiness pattern.
driverSubscription.tsx uses a resilient candidate-list approach for checkout/portal/cancel endpoints — survives future renames.
TabBar.tsx uses both HIDDEN_ROUTES explicit set AND descriptor href:null filtering — robust against expo-router version changes.
Subscription screen correctly gates CTA (S’ABONNER) vs management buttons (Gérer/Résilier) by isActive state.
No MongoDB _id leaks (local backend doesn't own data).
All interactive elements have testID (tab-*, menu-*, sub-*, toggle-shift-button, subscription-banner).
seed_data_creation: None — used provided driver credentials hoppla.me@gmail.com. Mocked GET /driver/subscription + POST /driver/subscription/checkout at the Playwright route level to exercise the needsPayment UI path without altering backend state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Local proxy at http://localhost:8001 forwards to UPSTREAM_API_BASE (shared-ride-pool.emergent.host). Driver subscription flow is fully wired: GET state, POST checkout (Stripe URL), POST portal (400 for this test driver per credentials.md — expected), POST cancel. Live backend currently reports status=active for hoppla.me@gmail.com, so to retest needsPayment UI you must intercept GET /api/driver/subscription at the browser (route handler returning status=none) or ask main agent to flip the backend state. Portal/Cancel return 400 (no real Stripe sub behind the manual 'active' flag) — not a bug.
rca_of_issue: Previously reported 'endpoint non disponible' is resolved: (1) frontend sends origin_url in POST body (buildOriginUrl in driverSubscription.tsx), (2) backend proxy forwards the request to upstream which returns a valid Stripe URL. Verified live with curl + Playwright. The checkout endpoint hits on the FIRST candidate (/driver/subscription/checkout), so the resilient candidate-list fallback is defensive-only.
